in_hebrew.name: Tobi
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is good
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tobi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Tobi means 'God is good'. This name has deep roots in biblical history, with the biblical character Tobiah being a notable bearer of this name.

in_greek.name: Tobi
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is good
in_greek.long_meaning: Tobi είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Hebrew, Tobi means 'God is good'. This name has deep roots in biblical history, with the biblical character Tobiah being a notable bearer of this name.

in_latin.name: Tobi
in_latin.meaning: Name of uncertain origin, possibly derived from Hebrew roots or Greek suffixes, conveying a sense of completeness or wholeness.
in_latin.long_meaning: Tobius, Tobi, Tobiam, or Tobiamus, likely derived from the Hebrew name Tobi, possibly meaning 'God is good' or 'goodness of God,' or from the Greek suffix -iōn, indicating a complete or perfect state. The name may have been adopted by early Christians to signify spiritual completeness or wholeness, reflecting a biblical theme of unity with God. In Christian tradition, Tobi has been associated with several saints and biblical figures, contributing to its enduring usage as a given name.
